Stratum: CMR = cardiac magnetic resonance; CCT = cardiac computed tomography; RUCC = Rural-Urban Continuum Code (USDA ERS 2023); EDI = Economic Deprivation Index.
Rate = accredited facilities per 100,000 adults aged 45 years and older.

Facility and county counts include every county in the stratum. Mean rates are calculated over the rate-eligible counties only, because a per-head rate is not defined for a county with fewer than 1,000 adults aged 45 and older (106 counties excluded; 3,038 of 3,144 retained).
EDI quintiles are formed among rate-eligible counties with an EDI value, so the rurality strata and the quintile strata do not sum to the same total.
Population denominators are American Community Survey 5-year estimates, 2019-2023.
